entities.summary: Mustafa Abdul Qadir Tlass was a Syrian military officer, author, historian and politician who was the Minister of Defense from 1972 to 2004 under Ba'athist-led Syria. He was part of the four-member Regional Command during the Hafez al-Assad era.
